00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000017.title: The lighthouse
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000017.synopsis: Three windows and a crooked door, above the harbor. Elin has kept the light for forty years. The one place on Bellwether that has never moved.
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000017.notes: The fixed point. Everything is measured from here, including memory.

00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000018.title: The harbor
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000018.synopsis: The only reliable point of arrival. Faces the wrong way, so the wind never quite forgives it. Nan’s shop, the jetty, and whatever boat Tomas is keeping alive.
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000018.notes: Every arrival and departure passes through here. Keep it ordinary.
